Job Title : Java developer
 Location : El Segundo, CA
 Duration : Full/Permanent
 

 Basic Qualifications:
 •Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.
 •At least 4 years of experience with Information Technology
 

 Preferred Skills:
 •At least 5 years of experience in experience in Java and J2EE, web services ( SOAP/REST) 
 •At least 2 years of experience of Performance testing tools like Jmeter, Load Runner, NeoLoad, etc.
 •Performance QA activities 
 •At least 1 year of experience in handling various data feeds in form of xml streams, events, files... etc.
 •At least 2 years of experience in Enterprise application performance testing (both GUI and Services) 
 •At least 2 years of experience in SOA and Web services (SOAP/REST) performance testing.
 •At least 2 years of experience in Oracle and PL/SQL with ability to write / test complex queries and joins.
 •At least 5 years of experience in Project life cycle activities on development and maintenance projects.
 At least 2 years of experience in Design and architecture review.
 •At least 5 years of Experience of performance testing tools like Jmeter, LoadRunner, NeoLoad, etc.
 •Experience in Workload modeling - testing process is a plus 
 •Experience with various types of testing like Integration, system, smoke, UAT, is a plus. 
 •Troubleshooting, Analytical and Client Interfacing skills  

 •Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent required from an accredited institution. Will also consider three years of progressive experience in the specialty in lieu of every year of education.

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
